excellent.title: Excellent
excellent.description: Value below which the air quality is considered excellent (µg/m³)

good.title: Good
good.description: Value below which the air quality is considered good (µg/m³)

fair.title: Fair
fair.description: Value below which the air quality is considered fair (µg/m³)

inferior.title: Inferior
inferior.description: Value below which the air quality is considered inferior (µg/m³)

name.title: Plugin Name
name.description: The name for this BTHome platform instance in Homebridge

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: List of devices to connect to and monitor

name.title: Device Name
name.description: Friendly name for this device (will appear in the Home app)

mac.title: MAC Address
mac.description: Bluetooth MAC address of the device (format: XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX)

encryptionKey.title: Encryption Key
encryptionKey.description:
32-character hex key used to encrypt the advertisment data.
(leave empty if device doesn't use encryption or it's disabled)

autoDiscovery.title: Auto-Discovery
autoDiscovery.description: Automatically detects the supported capabilities of this device based on the data it reports.

enabled.title: Enabled Services
enabled.description: Select which services to create for this device when auto-discovery is disabled.

pm25Breakpoints.title: PM2.5 Breakpoints
pm25Breakpoints.description: Thresholds for PM2.5 levels to determine air quality categories (µg/m³)

pm10Breakpoints.title: PM10 Breakpoints
pm10Breakpoints.description: Thresholds for PM10 levels to determine air quality categories (µg/m³)

vocBreakpoints.title: VOC Breakpoints
vocBreakpoints.description: Thresholds for VOC levels to determine air quality categories (µg/m³)

lowBatteryThreshold.title: Low Battery Threshold
lowBatteryThreshold.description:
Battery percentage below which the device will show as 'Low Battery' (if the device reports the battery level).
Configuring this overrides any 'Low Battery' reports from the device (if available).

threshold.title: Detection Threshold
threshold.description: Threshold level above which the device will show as 'CO2 Detected' (ppm).

powerOnTimeout.title: Bluetooth Power-On Timeout
powerOnTimeout.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) to wait for the Bluetooth adapter to power on before giving up
